questions.question: Why did Herod have John the Baptist beheaded?
options: Because of an oath he made to the daughter of Herodias
Because John had spoken openly against the high priest
Because the people had begun to call John a king
Because Pilate had ordered the prophet put to death
questions.answer: Because of an oath he made to the daughter of Herodias
